blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Visual foundation models are central to physical intelligence, yet their development remains constrained by fragmented training datasets, inconsistent annotation quality, and limited multimodal supervision. To address these challenges, we introduce GameRealm, a large-scale, richly annotated dataset that grounds visual observations in synchronized, game-native supervision. GameRealm encompasses over 120 million RGB frames and 1,000 hours of gameplay footage across all views. Beyond its unprecedented scale, GameRealm provides rich multimodal supervision, including metric depth, camera parameters, synchronized audio, control inputs, and 3D point trajectories. Its diversity further extends to flexible view configurations, spanning single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic recordings. To enable scalable acquisition across diverse game environments, we develop a unified data collection pipeline that combines human-operated interaction with agentic exploration. Extensive experiments across diverse visual learning tasks demonstrate that GameRealm consistently strengthens visual foundation models in both visual generation and geometric learning. These results establish GameRealm as a versatile and valuable data resource, unlocking new opportunities for advancing visual intelligence.
blocks.zh: 视觉基础模型是物理智能的核心,但其发展仍然受到零散的培训数据集、不一致的注释质量和有限的多模式监督的限制。 为了应对这些挑战,我们引入了GameRealm,这是一个大规模,内容丰富的注解数据集,将视觉观测作为同步,游戏本土监督的基础. GameRealm包含超过1.2亿个RGB帧和1000小时的游戏播放镜头,覆盖了所有视图. 除了其前所未有的规模之外,GameRealm还提供了丰富的多模式监督,包括度量深度,相机参数,同步音频,控制输入,和3D点轨迹等. 它的多样性进一步扩展到了灵活的取景配置,包括了单取景,立体声,多取景,和全景录音. 为了能够在不同的游戏环境中实现可扩展的获取,我们开发了统一的数据收集管道,将人类操作的互动与代理探索结合起来. 跨越各种视觉学习任务的广泛实验表明,GameRealm在视觉生成和几何学习中都持续地加强视觉基础模型. 这些成果将GameRealm确立为多能和有价值的数据资源,为推进视觉智能打开了新的机遇.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The pursuit of physical intelligence requires visual foundation models to understand not only the appearance of the world, but also its underlying geometry, dynamics, and interactions. Developing such capabilities demands large-scale, diverse, and richly supervised visual experiences. Modern video games offer a compelling source of such data, combining visually rich environments, complex scene dynamics, and interactive behaviors. More importantly, game engines provide direct access to precise, game-native supervision, including metric depth, camera poses, and motion information ( Li et al., 2026b ) , which remains difficult to acquire accurately and at scale in the real world. This unique combination of visual diversity, interactive dynamics, and geometric precision positions game environments as a powerful foundation for advancing visual intelligence.
blocks.zh: 追求物理智能要求视觉基础模型不仅要了解世界的外观,还要了解其基础几何,动态和相互作用. 发展这种能力需要大规模、多样化和受到广泛监督的视觉经验。 现代电子游戏为这些数据提供了令人信服的来源,结合了视觉丰富的环境,复杂的场景动态,以及互动行为. 更重要的是,游戏引擎直接提供精确的,游戏本土的监督,包括度量深度,相机姿势,运动信息(Li等人,2026b),这在现实世界中仍然难以准确和大规模获取. 这种独特的视觉多样性,互动动态,以及几何精密定位的游戏环境组合,是推进视觉智能的强大基础.

blocks.en: Despite growing demands for large-scale visual data, existing datasets remain fragmented across tasks and supervision modalities. Interactive world models require temporally aligned visual observations, control inputs, and audio to learn action-conditioned dynamics, whereas geometric foundation models depend on accurate depth, camera poses, and stereo or multi-view observations for 3D/4D reconstruction ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . However, as summarized in Tab. 1 , existing datasets rarely satisfy these requirements simultaneously. Conventional synthetic datasets ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Roberts et al., 2021 ; Zheng et al., 2023 ) , including SynthVerse ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , often depend on manually constructed environments, constraining visual diversity and scalability. Recent gameplay datasets offer richer environments but remain limited in supervision. SeKai-Game ( Li et al., 2026b ) lacks depth annotations, while OmniWorld-Game ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) relies on π 3 \pi^{3} -estimated ( Wang et al., 2026b ) camera trajectories rather than ground truth. Neither provides synchronized multi-view observations or audio, highlighting the need for a unified, scalable dataset with diverse environments, rich multimodal supervision, and flexible view configurations to advance both visual generation and geometric learning.
blocks.zh: 尽管对大规模视觉数据的需求日益增加,但现有数据集在任务和监督模式方面仍然支离破碎。 互动世界模型需要时间对齐的视觉观测、控制输入和音频来学习行动条件动态,而几何基础模型则取决于3D/4D重建的准确深度、相机姿势和立体或多视图观测(Wang等人,2025b); 张等,2026). 然而,如附件1所概述,现有的数据集很少同时满足这些要求。 常规合成数据集(Wang等人,2020年;Roberts等人,2021年;Zheng等人,2023年),包括SynthVerse(Zhao等人,2026年),常依赖于人工构造的环境,制约视觉多样性和可扩展性. 最近的游戏游戏数据集提供了更丰富的环境,但在监管方面仍然有限. SeKai-Game(Li等人,2026年b)缺乏深度说明,而OmniWorld-Game(Zhou等人,2025年)则依赖于 π 3\pi^{3} - 估计(Wang等人,2026年b) 相机轨迹而非地面真理. 既不提供同步的多视图观测或音频,也突出表明需要具有不同环境的统一,可缩放的数据集,丰富的多式联运监管,以及灵活的视图配置,以推进视觉生成和几何学习.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce GameRealm, a large-scale game-derived dataset that integrates geometric ground truth, synchronized multimodal signals, and diverse visual observations across single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic configurations. GameRealm comprises over 120 million frames and 1,000 hours of gameplay across diverse environments and interaction scenarios. We combine human-operated collection to capture diverse and context-dependent interactions with automated exploration to systematically navigate free-roaming environments. Through dedicated game-engine plugins, our acquisition pipeline directly accesses ground truth, establishing precise correspondence between visual observations and their underlying geometric and control information. The collected data include synchronized RGB images, metric depth, camera parameters, audio, keyboard and mouse inputs, and point tracking. Furthermore, we filter visually degraded and inconsistent clips.
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了GameRealm,这是一个大型的游戏衍生数据集,集成几何地面真理,同步的多模式信号,以及跨越单视,立体,多视,全景配置的不同视觉观测. GameRealm包含超过1.2亿帧和1000小时的游戏玩法,跨越不同的环境和互动情景. 我们把人类操作的收集与自动化探索结合起来,捕捉多样和依具体情况而定的相互作用,系统地导航自由移动的环境。 通过专用的游戏引擎插件,我们的收购管道直接访问地面真理,建立视觉观测与其基本几何和控制信息之间的精确对应. 收集的数据包括同步的RGB图像,度量深度,相机参数,音频,键盘和鼠标输入,以及点跟踪. 此外,我们过滤视觉退化和不一致的片段。

blocks.en: On the other hand, we examine the utility of GameRealm through multiple visual learning tasks. Employing the recorded player inputs, we fine-tune the world model to predict how the player’s view evolves under a sequence of keyboard and mouse commands. We then study the geometric information in these recordings by fine-tuning models for stereo reconstruction and multi-view reconstruction. Evaluation on public real-world benchmarks tests how well the geometric supervision acquired in games transfers beyond the environments in which it was collected. Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 另一方面,我们通过多种视觉学习任务来审查GameRealm的效用. 利用录制的玩家输入,我们微调了世界模型,以预测玩家的视野如何在键盘和鼠标命令的序列下演化. 然后我们通过细化立体重建模型和多视图重建来研究这些录音中的几何信息. 对公共现实世界基准的评价检验了在游戏转让中获得的几何监督在采集环境以外的情况。 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集

blocks.en: Synthetic datasets provide geometric and motion supervision at scale. MPI Sintel ( Butler et al., 2012b ) , Spring ( Mehl et al., 2023 ) , and Dynamic Replica ( Karaev et al., 2023 ) support optical flow, stereo, and dynamic scene understanding, while TartanAir ( Wang et al., 2020 ) , BlendedMVS ( Yao et al., 2020 ) , Hypersim ( Roberts et al., 2021 ) , and EDEN ( Le et al., 2021 ) target scene geometry and navigation. For temporal correspondence, FlyingThings++ ( Harley et al., 2022 ) and PointOdyssey ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) provide point-tracking supervision. Recent datasets, including Syn4D ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and SynthVerse ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , further extend synthetic data toward synchronized multi-view observations, dense 4D correspondence, and diverse interactions.
blocks.zh: 合成数据集提供规模几何和运动监督. MPI Sintel(巴特勒等人,2012年b),春季 (Mehl等人,2023年),和动态复制(Karaev等人,2023年)支持光学流,立体声和动态场景理解,而TartanAir(Wang等人,2020年),BlendedMVS (姚等人,2020年),Hypersim(Roberts等人,2021年),EDEN(Le等人,2021年)的目标场景几何和导航. 对于时间通信, FlyingThings ++ (Harley等人,2022年)和PointOdyssey(郑等人,2023年)提供点轨监督. 最近的数据集包括Syn4D(Jiang等人,2026年)和SynthVerse(Zhao等人,2026年),进一步将合成数据扩展到同步多视图观测,密集的4D对应,以及多种相互作用.

blocks.en: Game-derived datasets offer a complementary source of realistic visual observations and interactive supervision. Sekai-Game ( Li et al., 2026b ) provides gameplay videos with engine-derived camera trajectories, while OmniWorld-Game ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) combines renderer-derived depth with estimated camera poses and generated annotations. Despite these advances, existing resources provide limited combinations of multi-view observations, audio, and recorded control inputs. Moreover, estimated annotations and camera trajectories do not provide the same supervision as game-native ground truth and actual player actions. As summarized in Table 1 , GameRealm brings these capabilities together through synchronized RGB, metric depth, camera parameters, control inputs, audio, and point trajectories across single-view, stereo, multi-view, and panoramic settings. Its acquisition pipeline combines human-operated interaction capture with automated exploration, providing a unified resource for interactive world modeling and visual geometry learning.
blocks.zh: 游戏衍生数据集为现实视觉观测和互动监督提供了补充来源. Sekai-Game(Li等人,2026b)提供带有引擎衍生的相机轨迹的游戏播放视频,而OmniWorld-Game(周等人,2025年)则将渲染器衍生的深度与估计的相机姿势和生成说明相结合. 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有资源提供的多视图观察、音频和记录控制输入的组合有限。 此外,估计说明和相机轨迹并不能提供与游戏本土地面真相和实际玩家动作相同的监督. 如表1所概述,GameRealm通过同步RGB,度量深度,相机参数,控制输入,音频,和点轨通过单视,立体声,多视,全景设置,将这些能力汇集在一起. 其收购管道将人类操作的交互捕捉与自动化探索相结合,为交互式世界模型和视觉几何学学习提供了统一资源.

blocks.en: 2.2 Interactive World Model
blocks.zh: 2.2 互动世界模式

blocks.en: Interactive world models extend video generation to action-conditioned prediction of dynamic environments. Genie ( Bruce et al., 2024 ) learns latent actions from unlabeled videos, while DIAMOND ( Alonso et al., 2024 ) and GameNGen ( Valevski et al., 2025 ) demonstrate diffusion-based and autoregressive approaches to interactive visual simulation. More recent methods, including Matrix-Game ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) and Matrix-Game 2.0 ( He et al., 2025 ) , introduce explicit keyboard and mouse conditioning for controllable, real-time gameplay generation. These works establish action–observation alignment as a key requirement for interactive world modeling.
blocks.zh: 互动世界模型将视频生成扩展到对动态环境的行动条件预测. Genie(Bruce等人,2024年)从未贴标签的视频中学习潜在动作,而DIAMOND(Alonso等人,2024年)和GameNgen(Valevski等人,2025年)演示了基于扩散和自递的交互式视觉模拟方法. 最近的方法包括Matrix-Game(张等,2025b)和Matrix-Game 2.0(He等,2025),为可控,实时游戏游戏生成引入了明确的键盘和鼠标调节. 这些工作将行动-观察协调确定为互动世界建模的关键要求。

blocks.en: Beyond short-term action following, recent methods focus on long-horizon consistency and persistent spatial memory. WorldPlay ( Sun et al., 2025 ) employs reconstructed context memory, while LingBot-World 2.0 ( Team et al., 2026b ; Gao et al., 2026 ) , AlayaWorld ( Team et al., 2026a ) , and ReWorld ( Chen et al., 2026 ) explore causal generation, compressed history, and geometry-aware memory for extended interaction. Meanwhile, panoramic world models such as PanoWorld ( Li et al., 2026a ) address spatial continuity under omnidirectional viewing, and LTX-2 ( HaCohen et al., 2026 ) jointly generates synchronized video and audio. Together, these advances extend world modeling toward controllable, spatially consistent, and multimodal generation. GameRealm complements these model-centric advances with synchronized, engine-grounded supervision. It records visual observations alongside available player inputs, camera parameters, depth, and audio, enabling the adaptation of pretrained models such as Helios ( Yuan et al., 2026 ) and LTX-2.3 to action-conditioned perspective and panoramic generation. This explicitly connects interactive generation with geometric and multimodal information.
blocks.zh: 除了随后采取的短期行动之外,最近的方法侧重于长期一致性和持久的空间记忆。 WorldPlay(Sun等人,2025年)使用重建上下文记忆,而LingBot-World 2.0(Team等人,2026b;Gao等人,2026年),阿拉亚世界 (Team et al., 2026a),和ReWorld(Chen et al., 2026) 探索因果生成,压缩历史,以及几何感知记忆的扩展相互作用. 同时,全景世界模型如PanoWorld(Li等人,2026a)在全景下处理空间连续性问题,LTX-2(HaCohen等人,2026)联合生成同步视频和音频. 这些进步共同将世界模式扩展到可控、空间一致和多式联运。 GameRealm以同步,引擎定位的监督来补充这些以模型为中心的进步. 它与可用的播放器输入,相机参数,深度,和音频一起记录视觉观测,可以使Helios(Yuan等人,2026年)和LTX-2.3等预先训练过的模型适应动作条件视角和全景生成. 这明确将交互生成与几何和多式联运信息联系起来。

blocks.en: 2.3 Visual Geometry Grounded Learning
blocks.zh: 2.3 视觉几何定位学习

blocks.en: Visual geometry learning aims to recover scene structure and motion from visual observations ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026a ; Miao et al., 2026 ) . We focus on three complementary tasks: stereo reconstruction, multi-view reconstruction, and point tracking, which respectively recover depth, spatial structure, and persistent temporal correspondences.
blocks.zh: 视觉几何学旨在从视觉观测中恢复场景结构和运动(Wang等人,2025b; Wang等人,2026a;Miao等人,2026). 我们侧重于三个相辅相成的任务:立体重建、多景重建以及点跟踪,分别恢复深度、空间结构以及持续的时间对应。

blocks.en: 2.3.1 Stereo Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.3.1 立体声重建

blocks.en: Stereo reconstruction estimates dense disparity from calibrated image pairs and converts it into metric depth. Early learning-based methods, such as RAFT-Stereo ( Lipson et al., 2021 ) and IGEV-Stereo ( Xu et al., 2023 ) , improve correspondence estimation through recurrent refinement and explicit geometric encoding. Recent approaches further incorporate monocular priors to handle ambiguous regions: Stereo Anywhere ( Bartolomei et al., 2025 ) , MonSter ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) , and DEFOM-Stereo ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) combine stereo matching with pretrained visual or depth representations. FoundationStereo ( Wen et al., 2025 ) and Fast-FoundationStereo ( Wen et al., 2026 ) extend this direction toward robust zero-shot generalization and real-time inference.
blocks.zh: 立体重建从校准的图像对中估算出密度差异,并将其转换为度量深度. 基于早期学习的方法,如RAFT-Stereo(Lipson等人,2021年)和IGEV-Stereo(Xu等人,2023年),通过经常性的完善和明确的几何编码来改进函证估计. 最近的办法进一步包括了处理模棱两可的区域的单一前科: 立体声(Bartolomei等人,2025年),MonSter(Cheng等人,2025年),以及DEFOM-Stereo(Jiang等人,2025年)将立体声配对与预训视觉或深度表现结合. FoundationStereo(Wen et al.,2025)和Fast-FoundationStereo(Wen et al.,2026)将这一方向延伸至强势的零镜头概括和实时推论.

blocks.en: 2.3.2 Multi-view Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.3.2 多观点重建

blocks.en: Traditional structure-from-motion and multi-view stereo methods ( Schonberger and Frahm, 2016 ; Schönberger et al., 2016 ) recover camera poses and geometry through feature matching and geometric optimization. Recent feed-forward models simplify this process: DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) establish pairwise geometric reconstruction, while Fast3R ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025c ) , and VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) extend reconstruction to multiple views and online perception. More recent models, including π 3 \pi^{3} ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , MapAnything ( Keetha et al., 2026 ) , and Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025 ) , further improve flexibility across input configurations and geometric representations. Nevertheless, robustness to dynamic scenes, complex motion, and domain shifts remains challenging. GameRealm provides synchronized multi-view observations, metric depth, and per-frame camera parameters for geometric learning. We investigate their value by fine-tuning a pretrained π 3 \pi^{3} model while retaining its original objectives and evaluation protocol, isolating the contribution of game-derived supervision to cross-domain reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 传统的结构-从运动和多视图立体方法(Schonberger and Frahm, 2016;Schönberger等人, 2016)通过特征匹配和几何优化来恢复相机姿势和几何. 最近的向导模型简化了这一过程:DUST3R(Wang等人,2024年)和MAST3R(Leroy等人,2024年)建立对等几何重建,而Fast3R(Yang等人,2025年),CUT3R(Wang等人,2025年c)和VGGT(Wang等人,2025年b;Wang等人,2026年a)则将重建扩展到多种视图和在线感知. 最近的一些模型,包括 \ 3\ pi\ 3} (Wang等人, 2026b), MapAnything (Keetha等人,2026年),以及Depth Anything 3 (Lin等人,2025年),进一步提高了各种输入配置和几何表示的灵活性. 然而,对动态场景、复杂的运动和域位变化的稳健性仍然具有挑战性。 GameRealm提供同步的多视图观测,度量深度,以及每帧相机参数,用于几何学习. 我们通过微调预训的 \\ 3\\ 3} 模式来调查它们的价值, 同时保留其最初的目标和评价协议, 隔离游戏衍生的监督对跨域重建的贡献。

blocks.en: 2.3.3 Point Tracking

Point tracking establishes persistent correspondences across video frames under camera motion, occlusion, and object deformation. 2D methods such as TAPIR ( Doersch et al., 2023 ) and CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) improve point localization and temporal consistency, while recent 3D trackers explicitly model scene geometry and camera motion. SpatialTrackerV2 ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) jointly estimates 3D trajectories and camera motion, whereas TAPIP3D ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) tracks points in persistent 3D space. Correspondingly, TAPVid-3D ( Koppula et al., 2024 ) and SynthVerse ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) provide real-world and synthetic benchmarks for 3D tracking. Unlike projected 2D trajectories, world-space point positions provide direct supervision for separating object motion from camera motion. GameRealm records synchronized 3D point positions, 2D projections, depth, and camera parameters where supported by the acquisition pipeline, enabling the study of point tracking under diverse interactions and viewpoint changes.
blocks.zh: 点跟踪在相机运动,闭塞和物体变形下建立横跨视频帧的持续通信. TAPIR(Doersch等人,2023年)和CoTracker3(Karaev等人,2025年)等2D方法改进了点定位和时间一致性,而最近的3D跟踪器则明确模拟场景几何和相机运动. SpaceTrackerV2(Xiao等人,2025年)联合估计3D轨迹和相机运动,而TAPIP3D(Zhang等人,2025年a年)跟踪点则在持久性3D空间. 相应的TAPVid-3D (Koppula等人,2024年)和SynthVerse(Zhao等人,2026年)为3D跟踪提供了现实世界和合成基准. 与预测的2D轨迹不同,世界-空间点位置为将物体运动与相机运动分开提供了直接的监督. GameRealm记录同步3D点位置,2D投影,深度,以及获得管道支持的相机参数,使得可以在多种相互作用和视角变化下研究点跟踪.

blocks.zh: 3 游戏Realm 数据集

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Acquisition
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据获取

blocks.en: We develop a unified game-data collection pipeline that integrates human-driven and automated data acquisition, as illustrated in Fig. 2 . For interaction-rich scenarios, human operators provide direct control to capture complex interactions, while free-roaming scenarios are handled by an automated navigation system with frontier-based exploration and adaptive replanning. An agentic supervisor further monitors the automated process, detecting anomalies and triggering restarts when necessary. Data collected through both pathways undergo unified quality assessment and filtering to ensure consistency and reliability. The resulting dataset provides synchronized, game-native multimodal ground truth, including multi-view RGB images, metric depth, camera parameters, audio, keyboard and mouse inputs, and point tracking, supporting diverse downstream spatial understanding tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个统一的游戏数据收集管道,将人类驱动和自动化的数据获取结合起来,如Fig所示. 2 (英语). 对于互动丰富的情景,人类运营商提供直接控制以捕捉复杂的互动,而自由漂泊情景则由具有前沿探索和适应性规划的自动导航系统处理. 一名代理主管进一步监测自动化进程,发现异常情况,并在必要时触发重新启动。 通过两种途径收集的数据都经过统一的质量评估和过滤,以确保一致性和可靠性。 由此产生的数据集提供同步,游戏本土的多模式地面真言,包括多视图RGB图像,度量深度,相机参数,音频,键盘和鼠标输入,以及点跟踪,支持不同的下游空间理解任务.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Data Collection
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 国家 数据收集

blocks.en: We implement a dedicated game-engine plugin that provides direct access to engine-level ground-truth (GT) information, supporting two complementary acquisition paradigms, as shown in Fig. 3 (a): human-driven collection for gameplay involving complex, context-sensitive interactions, and automated collection for free-roaming scenarios that benefit from systematic navigation and exploration.
blocks.zh: 如图3(a)所示,我们实施了一个专门的游戏引擎插件,可直接获取引擎层面的地面真实信息,支持两个互补的获取模式:由人类驱动的游戏游戏集,涉及复杂、对背景敏感的互动,以及自动收集,用于从系统导航和探索中受益的自由浏览情景。

blocks.en: Ground-Truth Acquisition. The plugin directly captures game-native metric depth and camera parameters, following established practices in datasets such as TartanAir ( Wang et al., 2020 ) , and SeKai-Game ( Li et al., 2026b ) . Game-engine timestamps ensure temporal synchronization across modalities and viewpoints. We evaluate cross-view alignment on view pairs randomly sampled from GameRealm clips and report the reprojection errors in Tab. 6 .
blocks.zh: 地面真相收购. 该插件直接捕捉游戏本土度量衡深度和相机参数,遵循TartanAir(Wang等人,2020年),SeKai-Game(Li等人,2026年b)等数据集的既定做法. 游戏引擎时间戳确保了不同模式和观点的时间同步. 我们从 GameRealm 剪辑中随机抽取的视图对齐评价交叉视图对齐,并在 Tab 中报告重投射错误. 6 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: Human Collection. Human-operated collection primarily targets games with rich, context-dependent interactions. Representative activities include performing extreme-sports maneuvers, aiming and firing weapons, traversing complex terrain, and picking up or manipulating objects. These activities often require precise timing, coordinated controls, and context-aware decisions. Human operators execute meaningful gameplay sequences while the acquisition system records the corresponding observations and keyboard and mouse inputs. The resulting recordings follow the same unified ground-truth representation as automated collection, enabling both sources to be integrated into a common dataset.
blocks.zh: 人类收藏. 人类操作的收藏主要针对具有丰富,上下文依赖的交互功能的游戏. 具有代表性的活动包括进行极端运动,瞄准和发射武器,穿越复杂的地形,以及捡起或操纵物体。 这些活动往往需要准确的时间、协调的控制和了解具体情况的决定。 人类运营商执行有意义的游戏游戏序列,而获取系统则记录相应的观测结果以及键盘和鼠标输入. 由此产生的录音采用了与自动收集相同的统一地面实况说明,使两个来源都能够并入一个共同数据集。

blocks.en: Automated Collection. Automated collection primarily targets free-roaming games, where navigation provides a practical means of acquiring diverse scene observations. The collection workflow consists of navigation queries, frontier selection, automatic navigation, and synchronized capture. Game-native navigation queries identify reachable candidate destinations, and frontier selection prioritizes endpoints that extend spatial exploration. A closed-loop controller then updates keyboard and mouse inputs according to the player’s position and route progress. Movement stalls trigger route replanning to support continued exploration.
blocks.zh: 自动收藏. 自动采集主要针对自由漫游游戏,其中导航提供了获取不同场景观测的实际手段. 收集工作流程包括导航查询、前沿选择、自动导航和同步捕获。 游戏本土导航查询确定可到达的候选目的地,边境选择优先确定延伸空间探索的终点. 然后根据玩家的位置和路由进度更新键盘和鼠标输入。 移动摊位引发路线重新规划,以支持继续探索.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Data collection. GameRealm encompasses diverse game environments, first- and third-person perspectives, and a wide range of playable characters, including humans and animals. Data are acquired through two complementary strategies: human-driven collection for interaction-rich scenarios (top) and automated collection for free-roaming scenarios (bottom)
blocks.zh: 图3:数据收集。 GameRealm包含多样的游戏环境,第一人称和第三人称视角,以及包括人类和动物在内的多种可玩角色. 数据是通过两个互补战略获得的:人类驱动的收集用于互动丰富的情景(顶部)和自动收集用于自由浮动情景(底部)

blocks.en: During navigation, the acquisition system records multi-view RGB-D together with frame-aligned inputs. Timestamps are recorded for each captured observation and its corresponding inputs, enabling temporal synchronization across RGB images, depth maps, camera parameters, and control signals. An agentic supervisor is integrated into the automated collection workflow. It monitors runtime status, detects operational anomalies, and initiates restart procedures when needed. Its role is to manage collection failures, while navigation queries and the feedback controller govern gameplay movement.
blocks.zh: 在导航过程中,获取系统会记录多视图的RGB-D以及帧对齐输入. 每次捕获的观测及其相应的输入都记录时间戳,使RGB图像、深度图、相机参数和控制信号能够同步。 将一名代理主管纳入自动收集工作流程。 它监测运行时间状况,发现运行异常,并在需要时启动重新启动程序。 其作用是管理收集失败,而导航查询和反馈控制器则管理游戏播放运动.

blocks.en: We first validate video integrity and motion consistency, as illustrated in Fig. 3 (b). All expected views must be present, and each video is fully decoded to verify its frame count, spatial dimensions, and frame rate against the corresponding annotations and acquisition settings. Groups with missing views or failed integrity checks are excluded. We then resize video frames to a unified resolution and sample them at fixed intervals to estimate dense Farnebäck optical flow. For each sampled frame pair, we compute the spatially averaged flow magnitude and normalize it by the shorter image dimension. Clips with insufficient temporal motion or an excessively high ratio of maximum to mean motion magnitude, potentially indicating residual scene cuts or transitions, are excluded.
blocks.zh: 如图3(b)所示,我们首先验证视频完整性和运动一致性。 所有预期的视图都必须存在,每个视频都要完全解码,以对照相应的说明和获取设置来验证其帧数,空间尺寸和帧率. 意见缺失或完整性检查失败的团体除外。 然后,我们调整视频帧的大小,使其具有统一的分辨率,并按固定的间隔进行取样,以估计密集的Farnebäck光学流量。 对于每个抽样的帧对,我们计算空间平均流量,并通过较短的图像维度使其正常化。 时间运动不足或最大运动量与平均运动量之比过高,可能表明剩余场景切除或过渡的剪切不在此列。

blocks.en: We assess visual quality using complementary image-based and video-based predictors. Aesthetic Predictor V2.5, built on a SigLIP encoder, scores frames sampled at one frame per second; their mean provides the aesthetic score A v A_{v} for view v v . DOVER++ ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , in turn, evaluates the video through technical and aesthetic quality branches. The branch outputs are calibrated, combined, and passed through a sigmoid to obtain the video quality score Q v Q_{v} in ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) . Both scores are stored for each view and used jointly in the subsequent selection step.

blocks.en: To qualitatively illustrate the filtering results, Figs. 4 and 5 present representative examples of retained and rejected video clips, respectively. The retained clips exhibit clear scene visibility, coherent temporal progression, and diverse visual content across different game environments. In contrast, rejected clips suffer from severe exposure abnormalities, visual distortions caused by abnormal in-game character states (e.g., poisoning), or substantial view occlusions that obscure scene content. These examples illustrate how the filtering pipeline removes visually degraded samples while preserving informative and temporally consistent observations for downstream spatial understanding and learning tasks.

blocks.en: 3.3 Data Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.3 国家 数据注释

blocks.en: Unlike conventional video datasets that rely on vision-based algorithms to estimate geometric and motion annotations, GameRealm obtains ground-truth information directly from game engines through dedicated acquisition plugins. These plugins provide access to game-native information associated with game execution, enabling the collection of synchronized visual observations and corresponding geometric and control annotations.
blocks.zh: 与依赖基于视觉的算法估算几何和运动说明的常规视频数据集不同,GameRealm通过专用的获取插件直接从游戏引擎获取地面真实信息. 这些插件提供了与游戏执行相关的游戏本土信息访问,使得能够收集同步的视觉观测以及相应的几何和控制说明.

blocks.en: This acquisition paradigm establishes direct correspondence between rendered observations and their underlying engine-provided information, including depth, camera parameters, player inputs, and 3D point trajectories. All annotations are associated through engine-provided timestamps, ensuring temporal synchronization across modalities. Furthermore, geometric annotations follow consistent metric units and coordinate conventions, facilitating unified spatial interpretation across different data modalities. Consequently, GameRealm provides engine-grounded supervision without relying on post-hoc visual estimation for these annotations. Textual descriptions are generated separately using vision-language models and are distinguished from game-native annotations.
blocks.zh: 这种获取范式建立了提供观测与其基本引擎提供的信息之间的直接对应关系,包括深度,相机参数,玩家输入,以及3D点轨道. 所有说明都通过引擎提供的时间戳连接起来,确保各种模式的时间同步. 此外,几何说明遵循一致的计量单位和协调公约,促进不同数据模式的统一空间解释。 因此,GameRealm提供基于引擎的监控,而不依赖于这些说明的后热视觉估计. 文字描述是使用视觉语言模型单独生成的,并与游戏本土描述区分开来.

blocks.en: RGB observations. RGB observations are organized by recording, segment, and camera, with multi-view videos sharing a common local frame index and retaining source-frame boundaries. Representative sequences have a resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 , with corresponding depth maps, camera parameters, and available control inputs aligned to the exported timeline.
blocks.zh: RGB观察. RGB的观测通过录制,片段和摄像来组织,多景视频共享一个共同的本地帧索引,并保留源帧边界. 代表序列的分辨率为1280×720 1280\times 720,有相应的深度图,相机参数,以及可用的控制输入与导出时间一致.

blocks.en: Depth maps. Depth annotations provide numerical depth information in multiple formats, accompanied by corresponding decoding rules and invalid-value conventions. Metric depth, coordinate alignment, pixel registration, and annotation validity are documented and aligned according to the specifications of each data release.
blocks.zh: 深度地图. 深度说明以多种格式提供数值深度信息,并附有相应的解码规则和无效值惯例. 计量深度,坐标对齐,像素注册,以及注释有效性都根据每次数据发布时的规格进行记录和对齐.

blocks.en: Camera Parameter. Camera annotations provide 3 × 3 3\times 3 intrinsic matrices and 4 × 4 4\times 4 camera-to-world transformations for supported sequences. Coordinate conventions, rotation composition, unit conversion, and synchronization information are documented for each data release, including explicit transformation
blocks.zh: 相机参数。 相机说明提供了3×3 3\时的3个内在矩阵和4×4 4\时的4个相机对世界的转换,用于支持序列. 记录每次数据发布,包括明确转换的坐标惯例、旋转构成、单位转换和同步信息

blocks.en: Audio. Audio annotations include 48 kHz, two-channel WAV recordings, together with associated temporal and segment-level metadata. Audio availability, completeness, and temporal synchronization are documented individually for each recording.
blocks.zh: 音频 音频说明包括48 kHz,双通道WAV录音,以及相关的时间和段级元数据. 音频的可用性、完整性和时间同步性,每个记录都单独记录。

blocks.en: Keypress. Input annotations include keyboard and mouse states, such as directional keys, Space, and mouse buttons, with binary down and changed flags representing held states and state transitions. Where available, relative mouse displacements and frame-aligned timestamps are also retained to establish explicit temporal correspondence between user inputs and visual observations.
blocks.zh: 键压。 输入说明包括键盘和鼠标状态,如方向键,空格,鼠标按钮,二进制下和更改的旗帜代表持有状态和状态过渡. 在可行的情况下,还保留相对鼠标移位和帧对齐的时间戳,以便在用户输入和视觉观测之间建立明确的时间对应.

blocks.en: Point tracking. Point annotations represent persistent correspondences through triangle addresses and barycentric coordinates or vertex identities, providing world-space 3D positions and per-view 2D projections where available. Visibility, synchronization, point identity, and geometric validity are documented according to annotation readiness, with additional skeletal joints and skinned vertices available for selected hand sequences.
blocks.zh: 点追踪。 点注解代表通过三角地址和巴向中心坐标或顶点身份持续通信,提供世界空间3D位置和每个视图2D的预测。 可见度,同步度,点身份,和几何有效性按照注释准备度进行记录,额外的骨骼关节和剥光的顶点可用于选定的手序.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Data distribution
blocks.zh: 图6:数据分布

blocks.en: Video Caption. We construct hierarchical textual annotations for synchronized multi-view gameplay clips using Qwen3.5-Flash ( Team, 2026 ) , as illustrated in Fig. 2 (c). For each view, up to 200 frames are sampled after cropping and resizing, with original frame indices preserved. The model independently generates temporally ordered action descriptions covering entities, actions, spatial relationships, and state changes. These descriptions are concatenated into local captions and subsequently fused through a text-only call into a shared global caption, prioritizing the primary view while incorporating compatible information from other views. Both caption types are validated and retained separately for downstream textual conditioning.
blocks.zh: 视频字幕. 我们用Qwen3.5-Flash(Team,2026)构建同步多视图游戏播放片段的分级文字说明,如图2(c)所示. 对每个视图,在裁剪和调整大小后对多达200帧进行取样,保留原始帧指数。 该模型独立生成时间顺序动作描述,涵盖实体,动作,空间关系,以及状态变化. 这些描述被拼凑成本地字幕,然后通过只使用文本的调用连接成共享的全球字幕,优先排列主视图,同时纳入来自其他视图的兼容信息. 两种标题类型都经过验证并分别保留,用于下游文字条件.

blocks.en: 3.4 Data Statistics
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 数据统计

blocks.en: Data scale and modality coverage. GameRealm contains over 120 million RGB frames. Following Syn4D ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and SynthVerse ( Zhao et al., 2026 ) , we count synchronized frames from different cameras separately. Based on typical recording rates of 16–24 fps, we estimate over 1,000 hours of video summed across all views. Each RGB frame is paired with a metric depth map and camera parameters. Multi-view and panoramic sequences also include synchronized audio and action annotations, providing multimodal supervision for interactive world modeling. Fig. 6 shows the frame distribution across more than 50 games. The number of frames collected per game depends on the size of its playable maps, with larger game worlds generally contributing more frames.
blocks.zh: 数据规模和覆盖方式。 GameRealm包含超过1.2亿个RGB帧. 继Syn4D(Jiang et al., 2026)和SynthVerse(Zhao et al., 2026)之后,我们分别从不同的相机中计算出同步帧. 根据16至24英尺的典型录制率, 我们估计超过1000小时的视频总和, 每个RGB框架都配有测量深度图和相机参数. 多视图和全景序列还包括同步音频和动作说明,为互动世界建模提供多式联运监督. 图6显示了超过50个游戏的帧分布. 每个游戏收集的帧数量取决于其可玩地图的大小,更大的游戏世界一般贡献更多的帧.

blocks.en: Data composition. The dataset is predominantly composed of multi-view data (77.6%), followed by stereo (9.2%), panoramic (7.5%), and single-view data (5.7%). The dominance of multi-view data reflects our acquisition design, which prioritizes synchronized multi-camera capture to provide broader spatial coverage and richer geometric supervision across diverse game environments. Stereo, panoramic, and single-view data are collected as complementary configurations for specific visual learning tasks. Within the tracking subset, multi-view and single-view observations account for 63.9% and 36.1%, respectively. Among samples with explicit perspective annotations, first-person and third-person views constitute 45.6% and 54.4%, respectively, indicating a relatively balanced representation of the two perspectives.

blocks.en: Scene diversity. Figure 8 illustrates the broad range of environments represented in GameRealm, spanning natural scenes such as forests, grasslands, mountains, deserts, rivers, lakes, beaches, underwater environments, and caves, as well as human-made settings such as urban streets, villages, and laboratories. This diversity encompasses different spatial layouts, geometric structures, and visual characteristics, enabling the study of scene understanding and geometric learning across heterogeneous environments.

blocks.en: 4 Interactive World Model
blocks.zh: 4 互动世界模式

blocks.en: We evaluate GameRealm for interactive world modeling by adapting pretrained generative models with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) and lightweight conditioning modules. We investigate three settings: single-view action-conditioned generation, synchronized multi-view generation, and panoramic audio-visual generation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过与LORA(Hu等人,2021年)和轻量级调节模块一起调整预先训练的基因模型,对GameRealm进行互动世界模型评估. 我们调查三种设置:单景动作条件生成,同步多景生成,全景视听生成.

blocks.en: 4.1 Single-View World Model
blocks.zh: 4.1 单视世界模式

blocks.en: Network architecture. As illustrated in Fig. 12 , we adapt the pretrained 40-block Helios backbone. The backbone and video VAE remain frozen, while rank-32 LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2021 ) and an action encoder are optimized. Each frame is associated with a seven-dimensional action vector 𝐮 i = ( w i , a i , s i , d i , b i , Δ ​ x i , Δ ​ y i ) , \mathbf{u}_{i}=(w_{i},a_{i},s_{i},d_{i},b_{i},\Delta x_{i},\Delta y_{i}), (2) where w i , a i , s i , d i w_{i},a_{i},s_{i},d_{i} represent directional key states, b i b_{i} denotes the left mouse button state, and Δ ​ x i , Δ ​ y i \Delta x_{i},\Delta y_{i} encode mouse displacements. The action encoder combines learned discrete embeddings with an MLP for continuous controls. For each 33-frame training window, action features are temporally aggregated into nine embeddings aligned with the video latent frame rate. These features are injected into the diffusion-timestep embeddings and used to modulate all transformer blocks through adaptive layer normalization.

We optimize the flow-matching objective ℒ FM = 𝔼 ⁡ [ 1 N ​ ‖ 𝐯 ^ t − 𝐯 ⋆ ‖ 2 2 ] , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}=\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{1}{N}\left\|\widehat{\mathbf{v}}_{t}-\mathbf{v}^{\star}\right\|_{2}^{2}\right], (5) where N N is the number of target latent elements. Timesteps are sampled from a logit-normal distribution with underlying Gaussian parameters μ = − 1.651877 \mu=-1.651877 and standard deviation 1 1 , mapped to the descending Helios noise schedule.

Autoregressive inference. Given an initial frame and an action sequence, the model generates video chunks from Gaussian noise using 50 denoising steps. We adopt a hybrid prediction strategy: 𝐯 ^ t = { f 𝜽 0 , ϕ , 𝝍 ​ ( 𝐳 t , t , 𝒞 , 𝐮 ) , t ≥ 500 , f 𝜽 0 ​ ( 𝐳 t , t , 𝒞 ) , t < 500 . \widehat{\mathbf{v}}_{t}=\begin{cases}f_{\bm{\theta}_{0},\bm{\phi},\bm{\psi}}(\mathbf{z}_{t},t,\mathcal{C},\mathbf{u}),&t\geq 500,\\
f_{\bm{\theta}_{0}}(\mathbf{z}_{t},t,\mathcal{C}),&t<500.\end{cases} (6) Thus, the learned LoRA and action conditioning are active only at higher noise levels. After denoising, the frozen VAE decodes the generated latents into RGB frames, which are appended to the history for subsequent generation. All parameters remain fixed during inference.

Implementation details. We train at 384 × 640 384\times 640 resolution with a global batch size of 128 across 64 GPUs. LoRA and the action encoder are optimized using AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , 100 warmup steps, and a constant learning rate for 20,000 optimizer steps.

The original text-conditioned Helios serves as a reference rather than a matched action-conditioned baseline. Figs. 18 and 19 present qualitative visualizations on VBench and iWorld-Bench.

blocks.en: 4.2 Multi-view World Model
blocks.zh: 4.2 多景世界模式

blocks.en: Figure 20 : Training and inference of the multi-view world model. During training, Helios jointly predicts flow velocities for synchronized views conditioned on first frames, ground-truth history, captions, and camera motion. During inference, joint denoising and autoregressive history updates generate synchronized video streams.
blocks.zh: 图20 多景世界模式的培训和推论. 在训练期间,Helios联合预测了以第一帧、地面真实历史、字幕和相机运动为条件的同步观测的流量速度。 推论期间,联合解析和自转历史更新生成同步视频流.

blocks.en: Network architecture. As shown in Fig. 20 , we extend the adapted Helios model to jointly generate synchronized views. Each training sample contains two views from the same recording group and temporal window. Their visual tokens are concatenated into a joint sequence, enabling cross-view information exchange through self-attention. View-slot embeddings distinguish the two streams, while view-specific captions provide textual conditioning.
blocks.zh: 网络架构. 如图20所示,我们扩展了经过改造的Helios模型,共同生成同步视图。 每个培训样本包含来自同一录音组和时间窗口的两种观点。 他们的视觉标志被凝聚成一个联合序列,通过自觉可以进行交叉视图的信息交流. View-slot嵌入区分了两个流,而视图特定标题则提供了文字条件.

blocks.en: Camera motion is encoded using per-view trajectories and camera intrinsics. We first calibrate a velocity threshold for each game by aligning camera-derived lateral and forward motion with recorded W/A/S/D inputs from the primary view. The calibrated threshold is then applied to each view to obtain directional motion states, while relative rotations remain continuous. These motion conditions are converted into per-pixel origin–direction features and injected into the transformer through adaptive scale and shift modulation. The pretrained backbone and VAE remain frozen; only rank-32 LoRA adapters, motion-conditioning modules, and view-slot embeddings are optimized.
blocks.zh: 相机运动采用每景轨迹和相机内在的编码. 我们首先通过将相机衍生的横向和向前运动与主视图中录制的W/A/S/D输入对准,来校准每个游戏的一个速度阈值. 然后将校准阈值应用于每个视图,以获得方向运动状态,而相对旋转保持连续性. 这些运动条件被转换成每像素起源-方向特征,并通过适应尺度和转向调制注入变压器. 预训骨干和VAE仍然被冻结;只有级-32的LORA适配器,运动空调模块,以及景区嵌入被优化.

blocks.en: Flow-matching training. We follow the single-view formulation in Eq. equation 3 , applying the same noise level to both views while independently sampling their Gaussian noise. Let 𝐳 0 ( k ) \mathbf{z}_{0}^{(k)} and ϵ ( k ) \bm{\epsilon}^{(k)} denote the clean latents and noise for view k ∈ { 1 , 2 } k\in\{1,2\} . The noisy latents are given by 𝐳 t ( k ) = ( 1 − σ t ) ​ 𝐳 0 ( k ) + σ t ​ ϵ ( k ) . \mathbf{z}_{t}^{(k)}=(1-\sigma_{t})\mathbf{z}_{0}^{(k)}+\sigma_{t}\bm{\epsilon}^{(k)}. (7) The conditioning information 𝒞 \mathcal{C} includes the first-frame latents, historical latents, view-specific text embeddings, and camera-motion features. The model jointly predicts both flow fields and minimizes ℒ MV = 𝔼 ⁡ [ 1 2 ​ ∑ k = 1 2 1 N k ​ ‖ f Θ ( k ) ​ ( 𝐳 t ( 1 ) , 𝐳 t ( 2 ) , t , 𝒞 ) − ( ϵ ( k ) − 𝐳 0 ( k ) ) ‖ 2 2 ] , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MV}}=\mathbb{E}\left[\frac{1}{2}\sum_{k=1}^{2}\frac{1}{N_{k}}\left\|f_{\Theta}^{(k)}(\mathbf{z}_{t}^{(1)},\mathbf{z}_{t}^{(2)},t,\mathcal{C})-(\bm{\epsilon}^{(k)}-\mathbf{z}_{0}^{(k)})\right\|_{2}^{2}\right], (8) where f Θ ( k ) f_{\Theta}^{(k)} denotes the predicted flow for view k k , and N k N_{k} is the number of target latent elements in that view. We use teacher-forced ground-truth history, perturbing historical latents while keeping the first frames clean. Cross-view dependencies are learned through joint attention without an additional explicit geometric consistency loss. The timestep distribution follows the single-view sampling procedure, with the underlying Gaussian mean set to − 2 -2 and standard deviation set to 1 1 .

Autoregressive inference. Given two initial frames, their captions, and camera-motion sequences, both views are jointly generated from Gaussian noise through iterative denoising. Generated chunks are appended to their respective histories and jointly condition subsequent predictions. This preserves cross-view information exchange throughout the rollout. The frozen VAE decodes the resulting latents into synchronized RGB videos, with all model parameters fixed during inference.

blocks.en: We evaluate cross-view geometric consistency by comparing the relative camera rotation estimated from the two generated views at each timestamp with the corresponding ground truth. We compare two models trained on the same synchronized multi-view data from the same initialization, with cross-view communication disabled (B1) or enabled (B2). As shown in Tab. 5 , enabling cross-view communication reduces the inter-view rotation error from 39.93 ∘ 39.93^{\circ} to 19.80 ∘ 19.80^{\circ} across 88 evaluation cases, a relative reduction of 50.4%. Rotation and translation errors also decrease when Pi3X ( Wang et al., 2026b ) jointly processes both views and each trajectory is evaluated after independent alignment. Results indicate that cross-view communication helps the model preserve the relative camera orientation across generated views.

blocks.en: LTX-2.3 adaptation. We adapt pretrained LTX-2.3 for action-conditioned generation of equirectangular projection (ERP) video and synchronized audio. As illustrated in Fig. 22 , the video and audio VAEs, text encoder, and pretrained transformer remain frozen. We optimize only the LoRA parameters Δ ​ 𝜽 \Delta\bm{\theta} and an action encoder g 𝝍 g_{\bm{\psi}} . The encoder combines discrete movement and button embeddings with an MLP for continuous mouse displacements. Its outputs are temporally aligned with the video latent frame rate and injected into the timestep embeddings through adaptive layer normalization. For ERP generation, horizontal head rolling is applied to the video rotary positional embeddings (RoPE).

blocks.en: Flow-matching training. Let 𝐳 0 ( m ) \mathbf{z}_{0}^{(m)} denote the clean latent for modality m ∈ { v , a } m\in\{v,a\} , representing video and audio, respectively. For each modality, we independently sample Gaussian noise ϵ ( m ) \bm{\epsilon}^{(m)} and a noise level σ \sigma : 𝐳 σ ( m ) = ( 1 − σ ) ​ 𝐳 0 ( m ) + σ ​ ϵ ( m ) . \mathbf{z}_{\sigma}^{(m)}=(1-\sigma)\mathbf{z}_{0}^{(m)}+\sigma\bm{\epsilon}^{(m)}. (9) Conditioned on the clean first video frame, text, and encoded actions, LTX-2.3 predicts the flow velocity 𝐯 ^ ( m ) \widehat{\mathbf{v}}^{(m)} . We optimize the masked objective ℒ AV = 𝔼 ⁡ [ ∑ m ∈ { v , a } λ m ​ MSE M ( m ) ​ ( 𝐯 ^ ( m ) , ϵ ( m ) − 𝐳 0 ( m ) ) ] , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{AV}}=\mathbb{E}\left[\sum_{m\in\{v,a\}}\lambda_{m}\operatorname{MSE}_{M^{(m)}}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{v}}^{(m)},\bm{\epsilon}^{(m)}-\mathbf{z}_{0}^{(m)}\right)\right], (10) where λ m \lambda_{m} balances the two modalities and M ( m ) M^{(m)} denotes the corresponding binary supervision mask. The masked MSE is averaged over valid latent elements. The first video latent frame remains clean and is excluded from the loss.

Training consists of full-clip fine-tuning followed by chunk-wise autoregressive adaptation. In the latter stage, ground-truth latent history is provided through teacher forcing, while causal attention masks prevent access to future chunks. Historical latents serve only as conditioning context and are excluded from supervision. Given an initial panoramic frame, text, and action sequence, video and audio latents are generated jointly from Gaussian noise. The predicted flow is integrated from σ = 1 \sigma=1 to σ = 0 \sigma=0 . During autoregressive rollout, each generated chunk is appended to the history, and its key–value states are cached for subsequent generation. The frozen video and audio decoders produce the final ERP video and synchronized audio. All parameters remain fixed during inference.

blocks.en: We initialize existing Fast-FoundationStereo ( Wen et al., 2026 ) from its pretrained weights and jointly fine-tune the feature encoder, cost aggregation, and iterative update modules, while keeping batch normalization parameters frozen. Training combines public stereo datasets with GameRealm data using source-aware weighted sampling. GameRealm depth maps are converted into disparity labels using camera calibration, followed by geometric correction and validity filtering. We employ an iterative sequence-weighted L 1 L_{1} loss over valid pixels, AdamW optimization, and mixed-precision distributed training, with differential learning rates and cosine decay. The model is trained for 20,000 steps. We perform fine-tuning using 16 NVIDIA A800 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 我们从预先训练的权重中初始化现有的快速基金(Wen等人,2026年),并联合微调特性编码器、成本汇总和迭代更新模块,同时保持批量正常化参数的冻结。 培训将公共立体声数据集与GameRealm数据相结合,使用源认识加权抽样. GameRealm深度地图使用相机校准转换成差异标签,然后进行几何校正和有效性过滤. 我们使用一个迭代序列加权L 1 LQQ1} 损失超过有效的像素, 亚当W优化, 和混合精度分布式训练, 学习率和余弦衰减。 该型号经过2万步的训练. 我们使用16个NVIDIA A800 GPU进行微调.

blocks.en: To study the value of our game data for visual geometry learning, we fine-tune the released pretrained π 3 \pi^{3} model ( Wang et al., 2026b ) with its original geometric losses. Our baseline uses eight datasets from the π 3 \pi^{3} training corpus: ScanNet++ ( Yeshwanth et al., 2023 ) , ARKitScenes ( Baruch et al., 2021 ) , MegaDepth ( Li and Snavely, 2018 ) , CO3Dv2 ( Reizenstein et al., 2021 ) , TartanAir ( Wang et al., 2020 ) , BlendedMVG ( Yao et al., 2020 ) , GTA-SfM ( Wang and Shen, 2020 ) , and MatrixCity ( Li et al., 2023 ) . We compare this baseline with a model fine-tuned on the same base datasets augmented with GameRealm. Both models share the same pretrained initialization, view-sampling strategy, and optimization settings, and are fine-tuned for 10,000 updates using AdamW with cosine learning-rate decay.
blocks.zh: 为了研究我们的游戏数据对于视觉几何学习的价值,我们用它最初的几何损失来微调已发布的预训版的 QQ 3\\ pi^{3}模型(Wang et al., 2026b). 我们的基线使用8个数据集 来自 \ 3\pi\ 3} 训练机构: 扫描网++ (Yishwanth等人,2023年),ARKitScenes (Baruch等人,2021年), Mega Depth (Li and Snavely, 2018年), CO3Dv2(Reizenstein等人, 2021年), TartanAir (Wang等人, 2020年), BlendedMVG (姚等,2020年),GTA-SfM(王和沈,2020年),和矩阵城(李等,2023年). 我们把这个基线与一个在与GameRealm加成的同一基础数据集上经过微调的模型进行比较. 两种模型都具有相同的预训初始化,视图抽样策略,以及优化设置,并使用有余弦学习率衰减的亚当W对10,000个更新进行了微调.

blocks.en: We follow the evaluation protocols in the π 3 \pi^{3} paper ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , evaluating camera poses on Sintel ( Butler et al., 2012a ) and RealEstate10K ( Zhou et al., 2018 ) , video depth on Bonn ( Palazzolo et al., 2019 ) and KITTI ( Geiger et al., 2013 ) , and multi-view reconstruction on 7-Scenes ( Shotton et al., 2013 ) and ETH3D ( Schops et al., 2017 ) . As shown in Table 8 , fine-tuning with GameRealm improves 11 of the 12 reported metrics over the fine-tuning baseline, including reductions of 34.7% in Sintel ATE and 10.7% in RPE-trans. The gains are most pronounced in camera pose estimation, while depth estimation and multi-view reconstruction show smaller improvements and mixed performance relative to the original pretrained model.

blocks.en: Fig. 26 presents qualitative comparisons of the original π 3 \pi^{3} , baseline fine-tuning, and fine-tuning with GameRealm on motorcycle-riding and snow-sports sequences. The most apparent differences concern the spatial extent of the reconstructions and the distribution of observations across frames. These visual differences suggest that fine-tuning with GameRealm better preserves the spatial progression of the input sequence, complementing the improvements in camera pose estimation reported in Tab. 8 .

blocks.en: 5.4 Point Tracking
blocks.zh: 5.4 跟踪点

blocks.en: GameRealm supports both the evaluation and learning of point tracking. TrajRealm-Bench measures correspondence across diverse interactions and locomotion, while fine-tuning experiments with TAPIP3D ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and TrackEverything ( Jain et al., 2026 ) assess transfer to synthetic environments and real-world video.
blocks.zh: GameRealm支持点跟踪的评价和学习. TrajRealm-Bench测量各种相互作用和运动的对应性,同时微调TAPIP3D(Zhang等人,2025a)和Track的实验 一切(Jain等人,2026年)评估向合成环境和现实世界视频的转移.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics and input conditions. Following TAPIP3D, SynthVerse, and TAPVid-3D ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2026 ; Koppula et al., 2024 ) , evaluation reports average Jaccard (AJ), average percentage of points within distance thresholds (APD), and occlusion accuracy (OA). AJ jointly measures localization and visibility; APD averages localization accuracy across five thresholds; OA measures visibility classification accuracy. The benchmark and synthetic experiments report 3D and projected 2D AJ/APD together with OA; real-world evaluation reports AJ 3D , APD 3D , and OA. All scores are percentages, with higher values indicating better performance.
blocks.zh: 评价尺度和投入条件。 遵循TAPIP3D、合成Verse和TAPVid-3D(Zhang等人,2025年a); Zhao等人,2026年;Koppula等人,2024年),评价报告平均Jaccard(AJ),距离阈值内的平均点数百分比(APD),以及隔离精度(OA). AJ联合测量本地化和可见度;APD平均本地化精度超过五个阈值;OA测量可见度分类精度. 基准和合成实验报告3D和预测2D AJ/APD与OA;现实世界评价报告AJ 3D,APD 3D,OA. 所有分数都是百分比,较高的数值表明表现较好。

blocks.en: Benchmark methods are grouped by whether the complete tracking pipeline uses ground-truth (GT) depth and camera poses, including 3D lifting and coordinate conversion. MoSE3 ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , Track4World ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , and TrackEverything+ π 3 \pi^{3} ( Jain et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) use estimated geometry. CoTracker2.1 ( Karaev et al., 2024 ) , CoTracker3 ( Karaev et al., 2025 ) , DELTA ( Ngo et al., 2025 ) , SpatialTrackerV2 ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) , TAPIP3D, and TrackEverything+GT use GT geometry. CoTracker predicts image-space tracks and uses GT depth and poses for 3D lifting. The With GT group uses median scale normalization and depth-adaptive 3D thresholds. The Without GT group follows the MoSE3 protocol: first-frame camera coordinates, global L1 scale and translation fitting, a second median rescaling, and fixed 3D thresholds. Neither group fits rotation. Comparisons therefore use consistent scoring within each group.
blocks.zh: 基准方法按完整跟踪管道是否使用地面真实深度和照相机,包括三维升降和协调转换来归类。 MOSE3(Cheng等人,2026年),Track4World(Lu等人,2026年)和Track Everything+  3\pi^{3}(Jain等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b)使用估计几何学. CoTracker2.1(Karaev等人,2024年),CoTracker3 (Karaev等人,2025年),DELTA(Ngo等人,2025年),SpaceTrackerV2(Shao等人,2025年),TAPIP3D和Track Everything+GT使用GT几何. blocks.en: Proposed point tracking benchmark. TrajRealm-Bench contains 175 sequences and 104,306 camera frames across eight subsets (Table 9 ). Interaction evaluates point identity through contact, articulation, and occlusion: General covers everyday human, animal, and object interactions; Hard covers rapid motion and large pose changes; Embodied covers robotic manipulation; and Plant covers deforming leaves and branches. Locomotion evaluates movement through environments: General covers individual movement and navigation; Transportation covers driving and riding; Group covers intersecting trajectories and mutual occlusion; and Long-horizon covers sustained movement over more than 800 temporal frames.
blocks.zh: 拟议点追踪基准。 TrajRealm-Bench包含175个序列和104,306个跨8个子集的相机帧(表9). 相互作用通过接触、表达和隔离来评价点身份:一般涵盖人类、动物和物体的日常相互作用;硬覆盖快速运动和大姿势变化;健美覆盖机器人操纵;植物覆盖变形叶和分支。  Locomition 评估环境运动: 一般涵盖个人移动和航行; 运输涵盖驾驶和骑行; 集团涵盖交叉轨道和相互隔离; 长距离涵盖超过800个时间框架的持续移动。

blocks.en: Each sequence belongs to one subset, with Long-horizon sequences assigned exclusively to that subset. Recording-group splits keep synchronized views and adjacent windows together. Evaluation retains full sequences, with up to 256 unique annotated queries per camera input, initialized at their first eligible visible frame. The 191 camera inputs provide 42,173 queries. AJ and OA use a fixed visibility threshold of 0.5 on this benchmark. Scores are averaged across views within each source sequence and then across sequences within each subset; family and overall averages weight their four and eight subsets equally. CoTracker2.1, DELTA, and TAPIP3D use 16-frame windows with stride 8; SpatialTrackerV2 uses length/stride 200/196 offline and 20/14 online; TrackEverything uses 16/16 blocks with persistent scene memory; CoTracker3-offline processes the full sequence jointly. TrackEverything+ π 3 \pi^{3} estimates geometry in 60-frame chunks with overlap 30.

blocks.en: With GT geometry, fine-tuned TAPIP3D-camera achieves the highest overall AJ 3D and APD 3D , improving from 25.1/41.9 to 40.2/57.0. Its world-space counterpart improves from 25.8/43.2 to 39.5/55.6. Fine-tuning also raises overall OA from 59.5 to 81.9 in camera space and from 60.1 to 81.2 in world space. The gains span both Interaction and Locomotion, with particularly strong recovery on Hard and Long-horizon: camera-space AJ 3D rises from 4.1 to 22.6 and from 8.3 to 27.2, respectively.

blocks.en: Among original models, Hard and Long-horizon yield the lowest APD 2D scores for every With GT method. TrackEverything+GT illustrates the difficulty of sustained motion, with APD 3D falling from 79.2 on Embodied to 0.4 on Long-horizon. CoTracker3 outperforms both original TAPIP3D variants on Hard and Long-horizon, highlighting the importance of temporal association and occlusion recovery. Plant and Group expose a complementary challenge: similar-looking targets overlap in the image but lie at different depths. Original TAPIP3D outperforms CoTracker3, DELTA, and SpatialTrackerV2 in 3D localization on both subsets, supporting matching neighborhoods organized by 3D distance rather than image proximity ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) .

blocks.en: Transfer to real-world video. Table 12 shows gains for both trackers. TAPIP3D’s average AJ 3D increases from 18.1 to 19.3 in camera space and from 18.8 to 20.0 in world space. All three world-space metrics improve on every dataset. In camera space, DriveTrack APD 3D decreases from 21.3 to 20.7 despite improvements in AJ 3D and OA. Its average OA rises from 86.0 to 88.6, with a small decrease on PStudio from 86.0 to 85.4. These results demonstrate transfer across trackers and real-world settings while separating localization and visibility behavior.

blocks.en: Qualitative comparison. Figure 27 complements the quantitative results with world-space trajectories from a separate game-fine-tuned checkpoint. The recording group of the displayed sequence is excluded from fine-tuning. Sixteen-frame trajectory segments are shown at four time points using shared query identities, point colors, reference visibility masks, and a fixed viewpoint, without trajectory smoothing. During character interaction, the original TAPIP3D model shifts several lower-body tracks toward another character in the foreground. TAPIP3D ∗ keeps these tracks closer to the target character and the ground-truth trajectories throughout the displayed frames, preserving point association through the interaction.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced GameRealm, a large-scale game-derived dataset that grounds visual observations in ground-truth geometric and interactive information. By combining human-operated interaction capture with agentic automated exploration, GameRealm provides diverse and synchronized multimodal data across multiple viewing configurations. We further establish a scalable acquisition and quality assessment pipeline to ensure data integrity and cross-view consistency. Experiments across multiple representative visual learning tasks demonstrate its utility for interactive world modeling and visual geometry learning, with promising results in action-conditioned generation and cross-domain geometric generalization. In future work, we aim to enrich GameRealm with finer-grained ground-truth annotations, including human and object skeletons, pixel-level segmentation masks, and instance-level information, to support a broader range of visual learning tasks.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了GameRealm,这是一个大型的游戏衍生数据集,将视觉观测以地面真实几何和交互式信息为基础. GameRealm通过将人类操作的交互捕捉与代理自动探索相结合,提供跨多个查看配置的多样和同步的多式联运数据. 我们还建立了可扩展的获取和质量评估管道,以确保数据的完整性和交叉视图的一致性。 跨越多个代表性的视觉学习任务的实验,显示了其对交互式世界模型和视觉几何学习的效用,在动作条件生成和跨域几何泛化方面有希望的结果. 在未来的工作中,我们的目标是用精细的涂抹地面真实说明丰富GameRealm,包括人骨架和物体骨架,像素级隔断口罩,以及实例级信息,以支持更广泛的视觉学习任务.
